You sing a marching beat as you strike, then nod your companion toward the space your blow has opened.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Strike in the rhythm that carries your companions forward. Requires melee weapon.

Weak
3 physical damage.
Standard
3 physical damage; one ally adjacent to you may move 1 square without provoking.
Strong
5 physical damage; that ally may move 2 squares without provoking.
